title: VEX: Connect is offered once a download ends, without a reload
head: 3f341bb8670d55276f5415ac407efce9a3a7a26e
brief: Bug: after a VEX download ended, the Brain tab's Connect stayed disabled until a focus or reload, because the window's cached /vex/status still said 'download' (the bus announces the download's start, nothing announces its end, and the chain's finally did not re-read the status). Fix, HUD: hud/src/state/vex.ts re-reads /vex/status in three places (including the chain's finally), guarded so the newest-issued read wins and an older answer never brings back 'download'; VexView.tsx polls /vex/status every 2 s while another window's download or device read holds the port and stops when the daemon says free (status read only, no device action). Daemon: Vex.download's ended hook releases the device inside the same lock section that settles the record (release(locked=True)), closing a race where a status read could say 'download' for a record the HUD had seen end. Claims: no new device action, a download is still sent only from the owner's click-driven chain, the brain terminal never auto-reopens.
focus: poll lifecycle and what it is allowed to do
VX-UI-4a: no device action without the owner's click

ground_truth.mechanism: the 2 s held-port status poll is not gated on the pane being drawn or on an approval card being up, unlike the USB-check effect beside it
ground_truth.evidence: render an undrawn pane, or raise an approval card, while the daemon reports device 'download': GET /vex/status still fires every 2 s

ground_truth.mechanism: a superseded refreshStatus call resolves before the newest read lands, so the chain's await refreshStatus() can read a stale this.status at the 'before it downloaded' brain check and in the pause loop
ground_truth.evidence: issue a heardDevice/poll read, then the chain's read: the first call resolves with this.status still at the older value

ground_truth.mechanism: an older failing status read arriving after a newer success overwrites statusError, and no test pins the guard (the mutant that removes the guard from the error handler passes all 48 tests)
ground_truth.evidence: mutant: delete the seq guard in the catch handler; hud/src/state/vex.test.ts still passes 48/48
